subject: StrataWorks: intake + IT/security landing pad for demo
messages:
From: Timothy Hale <timothy@strata-works.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@strata-works.com>, it-security@strata-works.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 12:14:00 +0000
Subject: Quick demo request — need IT/security on call

Hi Soojin,

We signed up through the trial flow yesterday and I was hoping to get a short walkthrough with an AE + SE. We have a couple of blockers on our side (network egress policy + retention questions) that our IT/security team will want to validate during the session.

Best slots for us (UK) next week are: Tue 2026-10-06 09:00–11:00 BST or Wed 2026-10-07 14:00–16:00 BST. If those don't work, we can try late-afternoon UK time.

Cc'ing Aisha (product) and IT security (it-security@strata-works.com) — please loop whoever manages the networking policies.

Thanks,
Timothy Hale
Head of Data Platforms
StrataWorks

Attachment: pre-demo-notes.txt (brief customer checklist)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Timothy Hale <timothy@strata-works.com>
Cc: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@strata-works.com>, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 12:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — need IT/security on call

Hi Timothy — great to meet you (virtually) and congrats on getting started with the trial.

We can absolutely include AE + SE and invite the IT/security folks. Quick options from our side:
- Tue 2026-10-06 09:30 BST (30–45m) — AE+SE+IT OK
- Tue 2026-10-06 10:30 BST (45m) — AE+SE only, can add IT on short notice
- Wed 2026-10-07 15:00 BST (45m) — AE+SE+IT OK

Markus (AE) will lead the product walkthrough — Markus, can you confirm availability for those windows and whether you prefer 30 vs 45 minutes given the IT ask?

Also, can the IT team share a brief SOC/VPN whitelist checklist or a contact to request the network egress range? If easier, they can send the list to me and I'll queue it to SE ahead of time.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference

Thanks Soojin & Timothy — I can take Tue 2026-10-06 at 09:30 BST. Given the IT/security attendance, let's schedule 45 minutes to cover network and retention specifics plus a short Q&A.

Neha — would you please join for the technical portion and bring the quick whitelist + SOC2 summary? I'm happy to cover the product walkthrough and trial onboarding plan.

Timothy — I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 2026-10-06 09:30–10:15 BST (45m). If Raj or IT want to share any existing whitelist docs, feel free to attach them to replies or drop into the shared drive link below.

Proposed agenda (short):
- 0–10m: introductions + trial context (Markus)
- 10–30m: technical deep-dive (Neha)
- 30–40m: fit + rollout questions (Markus)
- 40–45m: next steps & action items (Markus/Soojin)

Drive link for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/fake/pre-demo-checklist

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0113

Appreciate it — looking forward to the walkthrough.
